## Objetivo
Complete integrated browser journeys across delivered features using the diagnostics and screenshot helpers from T01. This task owns acceptance tests only, not application changes, private-API security tests, visual/accessibility finishing or documentation. Feature defects are corrected in their owning implementation tasks before this task can pass.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] Playwright run via run_browser_tests at 1280x720 and 390x844 covers invite registration/sign-in, adding/editing a game, voting, confirming a night, suggestions, recording a play, updated leaderboard and game history. Two authenticated contexts verify live vote delivery without reload. Use isolated SQLite data and the current-code webServer build, never a reused server or development database.
- [ ] Journeys reuse T01 helpers to include pageerror/console.error in failures and write text error-context.md. Assertions wait on locators/events/responses, never waitForTimeout. Descriptive, unique viewport-only screenshots cover principal screens and post-interaction states under test-results/screens/, with the state-bearing element scrolled into view. Screenshots are evidence only, not pixel comparisons.
- [ ] npm test remains browser-free and green; npm test && npm run test:e2e includes fast tests and all browser journeys. npm run typecheck and npm run build pass. Authentication/private-resource rejection remains covered by T08 and resource-owning tasks, not duplicated as a separate security deliverable here.
